model_mirror_asymmetry.note: mirror about model x=0; nearest-vertex distance (a vertex-spacing floor of ~0.3-0.8 mm is expected even for a perfectly mirrored but non-identically-meshed surface)

front.note: half-width left minus right of outermost extents about the Mode-F axis x=tx (arms included); positive = image-left wider

back.note: half-width left minus right of outermost extents about the Mode-F axis x=tx (arms included); positive = image-left wider

reference_cross_view_consistency.note: front reference is clipped at the image top (hair/ahoge) so its height is a lower bound; widths compared at equal px above the sole assume the same px/mm in front and back (NOT VERIFIED).
